request: Can you go through the rest of the comments on my ethics paper and suggest fixes like you did on Monday? Put whatever is left into my checklist too. The final draft is due Friday.
final_message:
I reviewed all eight comments. Monday’s comma fix is already in the dam paragraph. I added one punctuation suggestion for the run-on after “worse off” and saved the seven remaining items in your checklist.

Start with your reply to Parfit. If different choices would bring different people into existence, why do you still think we owe them something? Dr. Lindqvist’s Wednesday update limits final-draft AI suggestions to wording and grammar, so the checklist gives you questions for developing that reply in your own words.

Monday’s citation suggestion is still pending. Check page 351 in your edition before accepting it. The final is due Friday, March 12 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern.
